verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own alert delivery to email, Slack, and Teams, plus a rule-triggered PagerDuty integration and Slack messages for APM traces. That covers the destinations, but nothing shows routing by project, environment, or severity, or per-rule thresholds for new issues, frequency spikes, or affected-user counts. Spike protection concerns usage volume, not alert thresholds, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: routing by project/environment/severity, per-rule thresholds (new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count), crash-reporting (vs APM) PagerDuty rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can route alerts by project, environment, and severity to Slack, PagerDuty, or email with per-rule thresholds — new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count

citations.quote: Alerts via email, Slack or Teams. Get custom alerts to where your team already works
Now when an issue is triggered from this rule, a PagerDuty incident will be created and your incident team will be notified by PagerDuty.
Select the Slack channel you would like APM trace messages to be sent to and click "Authorize".
